Guidance: Use a short name so suppliers can match your revisions.
Describe the product and how the end customer will use it.
If you choose a catalog item later, enter its exact model code and source page.
Name preferred materials or finishes and any constraints.
Give dimensions with units and identify each measurement.
List features that affect design or production.
State quantity per version, including the unit.
Give the marking method, location and artwork status.
Describe the retail pack and request proposed carton details.
Name the country or market where the product will be sold.
Name the delivery city, port or warehouse location.
Give a target arrival date or ask when the order could be ready.
Specify the sample and any supporting documents needed for review.
Request the currency, delivery term, named place and separate charges needed to compare offers.
